fullContentHtml:
HPSC Civil Service Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the mains result for the recruitment of Civil Services Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 102 posts. Applications for the HPSC Haryana Civil Service HCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 06, 2026, to February 26, 2026. The mains examination was held on 27, 28 & 29 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their HPSC Civil Service HCS Mains Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 06 February 2026
  • Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 26 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 28 April 2026
  • Prelims Exam Result : 04 June 2026
  • Revised Prelims Result : 01 June 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27, 28 & 29 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 22 June 2026
  • Interview Date : August / September 2026
  • Mains Result : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, BC, ESM : Rs. 250/-
  • Female All Category : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
